title: Deep Cross-System Simulation
objective: Make Multiversal's domains meaningfully affect one another through explicit governed integrations while preserving every source and target owner domain.

scope.purpose: Make Multiversal's domains meaningfully affect one another through explicit governed integrations.
scope.completion_gate: A declared integration matrix proves deterministic cross-domain effects with traceable owner-domain receipts and no hidden authority shortcuts.

selection_boundaries: SMB-06 is completed_verified before SMB-07 implementation.
SMB-07 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.
SMB-07 is a deterministic non-authoritative integration-matrix/correlation/replay layer; it does not become an owner of any source or target domain.
MIB-09 remains relationship/reputation authority; SMB-03, ODL, SCL and MIB-11/WCI retain organization, faction, settlement, strategic-consequence and World/location authority.

MIB-13 remains economy/current-price/scarcity/transaction/settlement authority; SMB-07 may correlate explicit settlement/base owner results to explicit economy owner results but may not calculate or mutate prices itself.
SMB-04/D28 remains travel/discovery/Adventure run authority, D05 remains role-safe discovery authority, and MIB-11/WCI remains World/navigation authority.

A9/D24 remains Investigation/Clue/Evidence runtime authority; discovery references may participate only through already-authorized/committed owner results and may not reveal hidden information or create clue truth.
Action/Effect/A7/A8 owners retain damage/combat-result authority; MIB-12 remains repair/crafting definition authority and APW-03/D26 remains Project/Activity/campaign-time authority.
SMB-05/CEL-03 remains derived base/production projection authority over its owner seams; D17 remains live Asset/inventory/resource identity/state authority.

Every accepted cross-domain effect must name a declared matrix edge, a committed source-owner receipt/result and a committed target-owner receipt/result; SMB-07 may correlate them but may not execute the target mutation.

No relationship-to-faction, settlement-to-price, travel-to-resource, damage-to-repair, discovery-to-investigation, base-to-economy or Adventure-to-World formula is authorized; causal values remain explicit owner-produced results.
No parallel relationship, faction, settlement, economy, resource, repair/crafting, investigation, base, Adventure, World, Action/Event, Project or cross-system authoritative ledger is authorized.
No autonomous scheduler, wall-clock progress, hidden action-authority shortcut, provider activation, public/tester distribution, migration or unrelated refactor is authorized.

Implementation must establish causal RED before production code and pass exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation, immediate-predecessor SMB-06 source-governance invariants, SMB-07 source-governance invariants and client typecheck.
SMB-08 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-07 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.

implementation_plan.name: RED integration-matrix acceptance seam
implementation_plan.deliverable: A focused Validation Core profile that preserves SMB-06 invariants and fails specifically because the bounded SMB-07 integration-matrix/receipt-replay module does not yet exist.

implementation_plan.name: Deterministic cross-domain integration matrix and receipt replay
implementation_plan.deliverable: A non-authoritative declared matrix covering all seven approved example edges and deterministic application/replay of source+target committed owner receipts, rejecting undeclared edges, owner mismatch, uncommitted evidence, stale revisions, duplicates, causal-link mismatch and hidden-authority shortcuts.

implementation_plan.name: Source-governance proof
implementation_plan.deliverable: Machine-checkable proof that SMB-07 correlates owner receipts across MIB-09, SMB-03/ODL/SCL/MIB-11/WCI, MIB-13, SMB-04/D28/D05, A9/D24, Action/Effect/A7/A8, MIB-12, APW-03/D26, SMB-05/CEL-03 and D17 without parallel ledgers, inferred formulas or direct owner mutation.

implementation_plan.name: Exact-head verification and closeout
implementation_plan.deliverable: Linux and Windows focused acceptance, source-governance invariants, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform receipts pass on one exact head before merge; then OPS3 records SMB-07 completed_verified and selects SMB-08 without starting it.

next_action: Create the SMB-07 RED acceptance/profile on work/smb-07-deep-cross-system-simulation, prove expected Linux/Windows failure at the focused missing-module seam after SMB-06 invariants pass, then implement only the minimum deterministic declared integration-matrix/owner-receipt correlation and replay contract needed to satisfy the completion gate.
